recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "A Leap of Faith Into Podcasting", "body": "Chris Mathieu told the hosts he began blogging on Facebook around 2016, interviewed researchers and authors he admired, and eventually left a corporate job to podcast full time, moving to Colorado on modest savings. He described a deep bathtub meditation with 432 Hertz tones, a blue light and a voice he understood as his higher self and spirit guides, and said its guidance shaped his decision. He argued that taking the first step triggers synchronicities, with the universe rewarding initiative and gratitude. The hosts welcomed that framing and congratulated him on the show's chart success."}, {"title": "Water, Nero, and Divine Twins", "body": "Gabe tied Chris's bath meditation to water as a threshold, arguing that savior figures from Jesus and John the Baptist to Mercury and Hermes are linked to water. He claimed that the Greek word for water, nero, matches a term for a world age, and that Eros, described as the first god born, has a twin named Anteros. Gabe added that a still pool was humanity's first mirror, making water the original twin. Chris answered with native traditions in which water carries ancestral memory, and mentioned Emoto's water experiments."}, {"title": "Contact, Psyops, and Walk-Ins", "body": "Chris argued that genuine contact experiences may involve a pure consciousness that appears differently to each person, while physical abduction tales could be psychological operations or military mind control. He relayed the book Chameleo by Robert Guffey, about a man allegedly harassed with advanced technology, and researcher Trey Hudson's theory that walk-in entities can briefly take over people during men in black encounters. Chris also claimed 5G and surrounding frequencies may block perception and meditation. Chance described a swing from believer to high skepticism of claims that are parroted without firsthand knowledge."}, {"title": "Skinwalker Ranch and Louisiana Cryptids", "body": "Chris shared encounters reported by his guests. He said former police officer James Keenan described a wall of faces shouting a couple's arguments back at him, and that researcher Ryan Burns, who lives near Skinwalker Ranch, reported shapeshifting figures and a coyote dissolving into dust. Chris also described Louisiana hunter Scott Pace, who reportedly encountered Bigfoot, dogman and mantid beings. Chris said he finds the witnesses sincere, and that his Paranormal Louisiana docuseries is due in July, with Skinwalker Ranch next."}, {"title": "Dylan Brings Vulci and Hammers", "body": "Dylan Saccoccio called in during the third hour and said he does not dismiss other people's accounts because he has had experiences himself, though he keeps them apart from historical claims. He argued that the Etruscan city of Vulci was among the ancient world's most significant sites yet goes unmentioned by Greek and Roman writers, and that the hammer-wielding, blue-skinned god Charun resembles Vulcan, a link he said nobody makes. The conversation then followed hammer symbolism through the Maccabees, Martin Luther, Martel, Nietzsche and the judge's gavel."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Chris Mathieu is the host of Forbidden Knowledge News podcast, where he interviewers experiencers and researchers of the fringiest paranormal variety. Tonight we will explore his journey as a podcaster and dredge up fascinating highlights from his renegade rogue's gallery of guests.
